items.title: Is Accenture (ACN) Still Worth A Look On Its McCoy Acquisition?
items.summary: Accenture’s McCoy acquisition puts mid-market SAP focus in the spotlight Accenture (ACN) has completed the acquisition of Dutch SAP transformation partner McCoy, adding the business to Accenture Edge, its mid-market unit focused on SAP modernization and AI driven operational upgrades. This deal gives Accenture a deeper presence in the Netherlands mid market and broadens its SAP capabilities for clients looking to update core systems, improve data quality and explore AI enabled workflows. items.title: ACN Stock: Why The Discount May Not Last
items.summary: At $185.28, Accenture (ACN) looks set up for roughly 44% of upside over the next three years under a moderate recovery scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. The upside is powered primarily by steady earnings growth, while a modest re-rating from depressed multiples provides an additional tailwind.
